thread:
dana: Hey @jess @matt @kumar — PR #33121 updates the fallback kernel path and adds a small eviction header toggle. CI is green but we need runtime + infra OK for a canary and a merge slot. Link: https://git.redwood/pull/33121

jess: I'll pick this up this afternoon. Can you paste the perf numbers from the load run? p95 for 512 tokens is the one I care about.

matt: Quick infra check: does this touch scheduling or require new node labels? If so we need a rollout plan.

kumar: I can own the merge window if runtime + infra sign off. Proposed window: 2024-04-02 22:00 PST. OK? :calendar:

dana: Perf snippet from the 8k qps sim: p50 42ms, p95 210ms, p99 340ms. No new node labels. Eviction header controlled by env var FALLBACK_EVICT. Example: ```bash
export FALLBACK_EVICT=true
```
jess: Good numbers. Please add the tiny unit test I left in the PR comments and include the env var in the canary config. After that I'll +1.

matt: Ran ./deploy/smoke.sh against the canary image — no obvious failures. One question: any DB/schema changes? If not, infra +1 pending runtime review.

ci-bot: Automated security scan: no high findings, 2 medium (one outdated axios, one lint). Details: https://ci.redwood/checks/33121

dana: I'll bump axios patch and push the test + canary env first thing tomorrow. Adding a short rollback plan to the PR description now.

jess: Left a couple of nits; nothing blocking. After fixes assign back to me and I'll approve.

kumar: Sounds good — scheduling tentative merge for 2024-04-02 22:00 PST. Tagging owners: @jess (runtime), @matt (infra).

dana: Pushed fixup, updated PR description with canary steps and explicit rollback (set FALLBACK_EVICT=false). Thanks for the quick responses.

jess: LGTM, leaving +1. :thumbsup:

matt: infra +1 as long as canary looks healthy and no schema work shows up. :white_check_mark:

dana: Thanks everyone — I'll run the canary and report back in #eng-oncall.
